admission.justification: Atomic message placement and digest-shared file custody prevent sends without durable context and rollback damage to another message’s picks, with injected failure evidence.

applicability: Filing one developer-channel message to an actual existing launch record before host delivery or holding.
conditions: The target task or admitted taskless agent selects its developer-messages folder; the complete message header names developer, recipient, message ID and time.
Image and text pick files are saved beside it under SHA-256 and named in the message; the full message is placed atomically before delivery/hold.
The folder lock protects digest-shared pick custody: before message placement, rollback removes only newly created files; previously saved files remain.
Held wake text ends with the filed message’s exact path and hash, preserving the full context outside the short held text.
exclusions: No public MCP tool registration or new role/agent binding is created by this developer channel.
Already filed message and pick files are not garbage-collected on delivery refusal.
This is not authority to bypass permission or recipient guards.
